cases.rationale: The /search input is passed through Python, but the essential unescaped output sink is Jinja |safe in the HTML template, outside the Python-only product-code scan.
The /products id query value is interpolated into SQL before sqlite3 execution; this is distinct from the login authentication query.
The /login username and password form values are interpolated into an authentication SQL query before sqlite3 execution.
The /admin route checks only for an authenticated session and then reads all users without checking the admin role. CWE-863 is reviewer-assigned.
The /profile POST update takes an email form value and updates the authenticated user with no anti-CSRF token check.
